summary: Occupying a generous corner plot within a popular and well-established residential area of Sunderland, this immaculately presented and comprehensively refurbished two-bedroom semi-detached bungalow offers an outstanding opportunity for a wide range of purchasers.
description:
Beautifully modernised by the current owner to a high standard throughout, the property combines spacious single-storey living with attractive gardens, off-road parking and excellent investment potential, with the added benefit of a tenant currently in situ paying £1,050 per calendar month. Ideally situated on Silksworth Road, the property enjoys a highly convenient location with a wealth of local amenities close at hand. There are a variety of supermarkets, independent shops, cafés and everyday conveniences within easy reach, together with well-regarded primary and secondary schools. Excellent transport links provide straightforward access into Sunderland city centre, the A19 and surrounding areas, making the property ideally positioned for commuters. The area also benefits from nearby recreational facilities, including Silksworth Sports Complex and Ski Slope, Silksworth Lake and Country Park, together with an abundance of scenic walking routes and open green spaces, offering an excellent balance of convenience and outdoor leisure. Having been fully refurbished by the current owner, the bungalow is presented to an exceptional standard throughout, with bright, spacious and thoughtfully designed accommodation perfectly suited to modern living. The well-proportioned layout offers versatile accommodation that will appeal equally to owner-occupiers seeking comfortable single-level living and investors looking to acquire a ready-made rental property with an established income. The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, a spacious lounge, a contemporary fitted kitchen, two generous bedrooms and a stylish family bathroom. Externally, the property occupies an enviable corner plot with beautifully maintained gardens extending to the front, side and rear, providing excellent outdoor space for relaxing, entertaining or gardening. A private driveway offers the convenience of off-road parking, further enhancing the practicality and desirability of this impressive home. Already benefiting from a reliable tenant paying £1,050 per calendar month, this outstanding bungalow presents an excellent turnkey investment opportunity, whilst its high-quality refurbishment, generous corner plot and sought-after location ensure lasting appeal for future owner-occupiers alike. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the exceptional standard of accommodation and superb position this wonderful home has to offer.

ENTRANCE Accessed via a contemporary composite entrance door.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY The welcoming hallway provides an excellent first impression of this beautifully refurbished bungalow. Bright and inviting, it sets the tone for the exceptional standard of presentation found throughout the property whilst providing access to the principal accommodation. Finished with attractive laminate flooring, the hallway benefits from a radiator for added comfort and loft access, offering useful additional storage potential. Serving as the central hub of the home, this spacious and welcoming entrance creates an immediate sense of quality and style that continues throughout the property.

LOUNGE The spacious lounge is a beautifully proportioned principal reception room, offering a bright and comfortable space in which to relax and unwind. A charming UPVC-framed double-glazed bay window allows an abundance of natural light to flood the room, creating a light, airy and welcoming atmosphere throughout. The generous proportions provide ample space for a range of lounge furniture, making this an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining family and friends. A radiator provides warmth and comfort, completing this attractive reception room that perfectly complements the high standard of presentation found throughout the bungalow.

OPEN PLAN KITCHEN / DINING ROOM Undoubtedly the heart of this impressive home, the open-plan kitchen/dining room has been thoughtfully designed to create a stylish and sociable living space, perfectly suited to modern family life and entertaining alike. Beautifully presented throughout, the room enjoys an abundance of natural light, enhancing its bright and contemporary feel. The kitchen is fitted with a modern range of base and wall units, complemented by laminate work surfaces and tiling to the splashback and preparation areas, offering both style and practicality. Integrated appliances include an oven, hob with a sleek black extractor canopy over, fridge, freezer, dishwasher and washing machine, ensuring the kitchen is fully equipped for everyday convenience. A wall-mounted gas combination central heating boiler is discreetly positioned, whilst a UPVC-framed double-glazed window and matching door provide excellent natural light and direct access to the rear garden. Attractive laminate flooring completes the kitchen area. Flowing seamlessly from the kitchen, the dining area offers ample space for a family dining table and chairs, creating the ideal setting for everyday meals and entertaining guests. A further UPVC-framed double-glazed bay window floods the space with natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere and enhancing the generous proportions of this superb open-plan living area.

BEDROOM ONE A generously proportioned principal double bedroom, beautifully presented and offering an excellent amount of space for a comprehensive range of bedroom furniture. The well-balanced layout creates a comfortable and relaxing retreat, perfectly suited to modern living. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window allows an abundance of natural light to fill the room, creating a bright and airy atmosphere, whilst a radiator provides warmth and comfort. Spacious and inviting, this superb principal bedroom continues the high standard of accommodation found throughout this immaculately refurbished bungalow.

BEDROOM TWO A further generously sized double bedroom, offering versatile accommodation that would be equally suited as a guest bedroom, home office or additional reception room if required. Bright and well presented throughout, the room provides ample space for a range of bedroom furniture, ensuring flexibility to suit a variety of lifestyles. A UPVC-framed double-glazed window fills the room with natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere, whilst a radiator provides warmth and comfort. This well-proportioned second bedroom complements the spacious accommodation offered throughout this beautifully refurbished bungalow.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom has been beautifully appointed with a contemporary white suite, finished to an exceptional standard and perfectly complementing the quality of the refurbishment throughout the home. The suite comprises a panelled bath with a mains-fed rainfall shower over, complemented by a separate handheld attachment, offering both luxury and practicality for everyday use. A wash hand basin and low-level WC are neatly incorporated within a modern vanity unit, providing excellent storage whilst maintaining a sleek and uncluttered appearance. Stylish tiled walls are complemented by contrasting tiled flooring, creating a contemporary finish, whilst inset ceiling spotlights enhance the bright and modern feel of the room. Further benefits include a radiator, an extractor fan and a UPVC-framed double-glazed window, allowing natural light and ventilation. Beautifully presented throughout, this impressive bathroom provides a stylish and relaxing space, completing the high-quality accommodation offered by this immaculately refurbished bungalow.

EXTERNALLY Occupying an enviable and generously sized corner plot, the property enjoys attractive gardens extending to the front, side and rear, providing an abundance of outdoor space rarely found with bungalows of this style. The frontage is predominantly laid to lawn and enclosed by fencing, with gated access creating a welcoming approach whilst offering a good degree of privacy. A private driveway provides ample off-road parking for several vehicles and extends to the side of the property, leading to the rear garden. The rear garden has been thoughtfully designed to create a private and enclosed outdoor retreat, ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. Featuring a combination of paved patio areas and an attractive raised timber decking area, there is ample space for outdoor dining and seating, making it the perfect setting to enjoy the warmer months. Beautifully enclosed and easy to maintain, this delightful garden perfectly complements the high standard of accommodation offered throughout this immaculately presented bungalow.
